name: SAM-II riboswitch bound to S-adenosylmethionine
preparationNotes: Trimeric crystal structure (chains A, B, C). Chain A selected (SAM at A:100). CS (cesium, crystallization), MG (per Mg anomaly policy), PO4 (crystallization phosphates) all removed. Box 25x25x25 A — SAM is larger than free bases. Actives/decoys reused from SAM-I case (2YGH) for direct cross-fold comparison.
source: RCSB PDB 2QWY; Gilbert SD et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2008 doi:10.1038/nsmb.1371
affinitySource: Gilbert et al. 2008; Kd ~1 uM for SAM
affinityNotes: SAM-II riboswitch from T. tengcongensis metK mRNA. Completely different fold from SAM-I despite binding same SAM ligand. Kd ~1 uM. Key paired case: same enrichment library as 2YGH SAM-I enables direct fold-dependent scoring comparison.
notes: SAM-II riboswitch, 2.80 A X-ray. Adenosyl stacks on G11; methionine sulfonium contacts A42/A43. Different topology from SAM-I — beta-pseudoknot fold vs SAM-I alpha helix arrangement.
